Summary: Ensures onboarding kickoff closes with explicit owners, milestones, risks, and next actions.
EntryCriteria: Kickoff agenda and pre-read materials have been prepared.
ExitCriteria: Kickoff closes only when owners, risks, milestones, and next actions are explicit and reviewable.
Checks: Customer-side and delivery-side owners are named.
Milestones and near-term sequencing are recorded.
Open decisions have owners and due dates.
Next actions are captured with accountable names.
